maxRegexRolls.label: Max Regex Roll Attempts
maxRegexRolls.description: Hard upper limit on currency rolls executed in a single Roll Until Regex Match request.

vendorAllRequiresConfirmation.label: Confirm Before Vendor All
vendorAllRequiresConfirmation.description: When true, clicking Vendor All once prompts for confirmation before selling eligible items in the active stash tab.

bulkUseMaxActions.label: Max Bulk Stack Actions
bulkUseMaxActions.description: Maximum number of item uses executed per Ctrl+Shift+RMB bulk stack trigger.

pobAutoApplyOnLevelUp.label: Auto-Apply PoB Passives On Level Up
pobAutoApplyOnLevelUp.description: Automatically allocates the next connected planned passive skill nodes whenever the character levels up.

upgradeCorruptedMaps.label: Include Corrupted Maps In 3-to-1 Upgrade
upgradeCorruptedMaps.description: When false (default), corrupted maps are skipped during Map Stash 3-to-1 tier upgrades.
